arabic_locator.text: وَعَنْ عَطَاءٍ الْخُرَاسَانِيِّ: ﴿وَانْحَرْ﴾ أَيْ: ارْفَعْ صُلْبَكَ بَعْدَ الرُّكُوعِ وَاعْتَدِلْ، وَأَبْرِزْ نَحْرَكَ، يَعْنِي بِهِ الِاعْتِدَالَ. رَوَاهُ ابْنُ أَبِي حَاتِمٍ.

semantic_candidate.statement_en: Ibn Kathir reports from Ata al-Khurasani an interpretation of wanhar as raising and straightening the back after bowing and bringing the upper chest forward, explained as standing upright.

roles.Ibn_Abi_Hatim: named reporting authority in rawahu Ibn Abi Hatim, not the originating interpreter

fidelity_notes: بعد الركوع limits the interpretation to after bowing; do not replace with opening prayer or every takbir.
ارفع صلبك واعتدل specifies raising/straightening the back; أبرز نحرك retains upper-chest wording.
يعني به الاعتدال explains standing upright; its exact authorial versus transmitted scope needs review before a separate proposition is asserted.
رواه ابن أبي حاتم supplies a reporting attribution, not a full printed transmitter chain or independently verified collection locator.
